text:
lena: Morning all — quick precut snapshot. Cut window scheduled for 15:00 UTC. Current cherry queue: 7 PRs. Major notes: flaky e2e on canary, one customer staging token expired, and potential GPU contention in us-west. Post 1-line status: what you did, any blockers, and if you need GPU swap. cc @release-bot

release-bot: Canary rollout triggered at 12:36 UTC for release/x. Preliminary checks passed (smoke). Will post canary metrics in thread.

raja: Merged PR #4821 (kv-cache fix) into candidate. Backport needed to 0.9.x. CI passed but I'm seeing e2e failure locally: `tests/e2e/test_long_sequence.py::test_kv_cache_restarts` times out intermittently. Logs: ```ERROR test_kv_cache_restarts - Timeout after 300s
Trace: inference loop hung at kernels.select_kernel()
``` Trying a repro with smaller batch now. Blocker for cut if we can't stabilize e2e.

sam: I swapped the canary GPU at 12:40 (p4 -> p3). Triggered new canary. Observed a latency bump ~12:52 but canary still served requests. PR #4790 awaiting review (perf regression guard). If we need more capacity I can request a burst, but ops flagged quota.

jin: Reviewing #4790 now, should be done by 13:10 UTC. No code blockers from my side. If sam needs approval earlier ping me in threads.

ops: Heads up — autoscaler reported a transient capacity pressure in us-west at 12:45 UTC. It attempted burst allocation and fell back to queued pods for ~90s. I've increased temporary burst quota for release-train until 14:00 UTC. Also put a soft quota on non-essential batch jobs. If you see more droputs, tell me which jobs to deprioritize.

maria: Blocker: staging token for customer ACME expired at 12:30 UTC; can't run their verification evals. Opened SR-6123 with SRE. If cut goes ahead we should exclude ACME eval set from quality checks to avoid false red.

release-bot: Canary metrics (12:36–12:58): 99th latency 1.8s -> spike to 31s at 12:52 for ~2m, error rate +0.6% during spike. Traces point to kernel selection fallback on long sequences. Canary automatically rolled to prior kernel variant at 12:55.

raja: Thanks @release-bot. Reproduced the kernel fallback locally when sequence len > 10k. Adding a guard in runtime to fail fast rather than fallback will be quicker. I'll open hotfix PR and request backport.

lena: Plan propose: 1) Hold cut for up to 30m if e2e still flaky OR proceed with selective cut excluding ACME evals and non-critical PRs (we'll ship only 4/7). 2) Raja to open hotfix PR and backport. 3) Jin to finish review on #4790. 4) Ops to keep burst quota until 14:00 and notify if further pressure. 5) Maria to coordinate SR for token renewal. If no major regressions in next 20m we proceed. :thumbsup:

sam: Acknowledged — I'll mark PRs with "hold-if-e2e-failing" label and queue the rest. If ops revokes burst I'll trigger a lightweight rollout (smaller batch config) to avoid latency spikes.

ops: Will update if quota changes. If cut proceeds and we need extra capacity after 14:00, open a follow-up ticket and I'll prioritize.

jin: Done with review, left one small comment. No showstopper.

raja: Hotfix PR opened: #4830. Backport branch created `release/0.9.1-kv-fix`. Running CI now.

maria: SR-6123 updated: token renewed for ACME staging at 13:05 UTC. Re-running their evals — will report any fails.

lena: Thanks. I'll reconvene at 13:10 UTC for a final go/no-go. If anyone hits new blockers drop a short note here.

release-bot: Note: scheduled cut at 15:00 UTC remains in pipeline. Canary status will be rechecked at 13:10 and 13:40 UTC automatically.

lena: End of quick standup — appreciate the quick updates.
